answer: Cross-epoch answer-fingerprint drift audit resists sybils: the system fingerprints each author's answers across epochs and flags an identity whose fingerprints cluster too tightly — a ridge of near-identical submissions betraying template reuse no genuine author sustains. An atlas of an operator's fakes all drawing from one template shows a telltale low-drift signature; honest authors wander like a willow across distinct mechanisms. Low cross-epoch drift flags template-farming at the per-identity AND per-family level, catching both one faker and a coordinated ring.
